hero.title: High-volume industrial printing with consistent quality
hero.description: From sheet-fed offset and book production to packaging and post-press finishing — every stage happens in one facility, so lead time and quality stay under control.
hero.imageAlt: Offset printing line on the Mobin Bartar production floor

services.title: What we produce
services.description: Ten groups of printing and packaging services, all under one roof and one quality-control team.

why.title: Why corporate clients choose us
why.description: The difference between an industrial printer and a print shop is repeatability.

quality.title: Documented quality control
quality.description: Colour managed to ISO 12647-2, with every job's parameters recorded so reprints match the original.

capacity.title: High production capacity
capacity.description: Over 200,000 square metres printed monthly — large runs are produced in-house, never subcontracted.

integrated.title: Integrated production
integrated.description: Pre-press, press and post-press in one facility, so work never shuttles between workshops.

onTime.title: Delivery you can plan around
onTime.description: Fixed production calendars for periodicals and a firm delivery date stated on every quotation.

equipment.title: Our production machinery
equipment.description: Print quality is a direct result of the presses and how well they are maintained.

portfolio.title: Recent projects

production.description: Printing, post-press finishing and packing run to the agreed schedule.

portfolio.title: Portfolio

about.title: About Mobin Bartar
about.description: More than two decades of industrial print production for publishers, industry and institutions.

story.title: Our story
story.description: Mobin Bartar started in 2000 with a single two-colour offset press. Today, with eight active production lines and 140 staff, it is a well-established name in Iranian industrial printing. That growth came from steady investment in machinery and technical training — not from rapid, unplanned expansion.

precision.title: Precision
precision.description: Every job is produced against documented parameters so the next run matches the last one.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.description: The delivery date we state is the date we hold ourselves to.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.description: Specifications, stock and costs are agreed in writing before production starts.

investment.title: Technical investment
investment.description: Press renewal and operator training are a permanent part of our annual plan.

certifications.title: Standards & certifications
certifications.description: Our quality control follows recognised printing-industry standards.

facility.title: The facility
facility.description: Our 6,500 square-metre plant operates in Tehran's Print & Publishing Industrial Park.
